_comment: Evidence ledger for `introduced` (docs/decisions/introduced-evidence.md). One row per key of tools/introduced_snapshot.json. class: iso_primary (an ISO or ISO 3166/MA document), ma_member (a member of the ISO 3166/MA quoting ISO; never adopted alone), lead_only (points to a document, dates nothing), inference (a conclusion, not a reading). Only an iso_primary row with verdict adopted may set a value; its candidate must equal iso3166.json. ISO documents are not committed: doc records title, number, date, URLs, locator and the sha256 of the bytes read. Checked by tools/check_introduced_evidence.py.
